<thought>The observed isotopic pattern (dominant peak at m/z 193, followed by peaks at +1, +2, +3… with relative intensities ~12.5 %, 1.1 %, 0.08 %…) matches the binomial distribution expected for 13C isotopes in a molecule containing roughly 12–13 carbon atoms. No other element shows a characteristic pattern of this magnitude in the spectrum, so carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
